"""Native F-A BEFORE/AFTER over existing source-shaped fixture owners."""
import sys, json, hashlib, shutil, sqlite3, tempfile, zipfile
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, UTC, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

owned = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source_root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
if source_root.name == "frozen" and not source_root.exists():
    with zipfile.ZipFile(owned / "frozen.zip") as archive:
        archive.extractall(source_root)
sys.path[:0] = [str(source_root / "tests"), str(source_root / "src"), str(source_root)]
from test_trading_core_operational_closure_v1 import OperatingDriverTests, EpisodeScenario, nominate, token_object, synth_mint
from solana_alpha_lab.factory.trading_coordinator import TradingCoordinator, restore_native_backup
from solana_alpha_lab.factory.trading_runner import TradingContinuityRunner
from solana_alpha_lab.factory.paper_plane import PaperPlaneStore, begin_modeled_attempt, accept_signal_decision_outcome
from scripts.prove_trading_core_operational_closure import RecordingQuoteAdapter

def raw(path):
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)) as db:
        db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        return {"positions": [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM positions ORDER BY position_id")],
            "bots": [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM bot_instances ORDER BY bot_instance_id")],
            "ordinary_state": [dict(r) for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM ordinary_state ORDER BY mode")],
            "events": [{**dict(r), "payload_json": json.loads(r["payload_json"])} for r in db.execute("SELECT * FROM execution_events ORDER BY rowid")]}

def attempt(call):
    try:
        return call()
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"exception_type": type(exc).__name__, "reason_code": str(exc)}

def fixture():
    saved = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory
    with patch("tempfile.TemporaryDirectory", lambda *a, **k: saved(*a, dir=owned, **k)):
        case = OperatingDriverTests("test_C07_C08_C09_positive_successor_and_old_exit")
        case.setUp()
    return case

out = {"source_hashes": {rel: hashlib.sha256((source_root / rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in (
    "src/solana_alpha_lab/factory/paper_plane.py", "src/solana_alpha_lab/factory/trading_runner.py",
    "src/solana_alpha_lab/factory/trading_runtime_policy.py", "src/solana_alpha_lab/factory/trading_coordinator.py")}}
case = fixture()
try:
    try:
        case.start_operating()
    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps({"ticks": case.source.ticks, "rounds": case.source.rounds()}, default=str), file=sys.stderr)
        raise
    case.coordinator.tick()
    old_epoch, old_runner, old_profile = case.epoch, case.runner, case.profile
    case.prepare(operating=True, suffix="-B", negative=True, exit_point="E3600")
    start = datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 16, 6, tzinfo=UTC)
    feed = EpisodeScenario(case.data / "successor-source", start=start, stops=start + timedelta(hours=3))
    mint = synth_mint("DeniedB")
    obj = token_object(mint, price=.000003, liquidity=10000, holders=66)
    nominate(feed.market, start, {"toptraded": [obj], "toptrending": [obj]})
    feed.market.series[mint] = lambda now: token_object(mint, price=.000003, liquidity=10000,
        holders=60 if now >= datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 50, tzinfo=UTC) else 66)
    feed.tick(start)
    feed.tick(datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 25, tzinfo=UTC))
    profile = {**old_profile, "source": {"root": str(feed.data_root), "file": "observation_schedule_state.sqlite",
        "schedule_sha256": feed.schedule["schedule_sha256"], "activation_id": feed.activation_id}}
    now = [datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 41, tzinfo=UTC)]
    coordinator = TradingCoordinator(case.runner, mode="PAPER", clock=lambda: now[0])
    coordinator.activate(epoch_id=case.epoch, at="2026-10-05T12:41:00Z", profile=profile,
        switch_key="PATCH-B", expected_current_epoch=old_epoch)
    feed.tick(datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 50, tzinfo=UTC))
    now[0] = datetime(2026, 10, 5, 12, 55, tzinfo=UTC)
    coordinator.tick()
    before = raw(case.runner.store_path)
    admission = feed.admissions()[0]
    episode = case.runner.episode(source_relative="successor-source/observation_schedule_state.sqlite",
        episode_id=admission["episode_id"], epoch_id=case.epoch, mode="PAPER", as_of="2026-10-05T12:55:00Z")
    store = PaperPlaneStore(case.runner.store_path)
    try:
        direct = accept_signal_decision_outcome(case.root, store, strategy=case.runner.strategy,
            signal_decision=episode["decision"], known_activation_epochs={case.epoch}, mode="PAPER",
            as_of="2026-10-05T12:55:00Z", skip_fill=True, ordinary_operating=False)
    finally:
        store.close()
    pid = episode["admission"].get("position_id")
    claim = None if pid is None else attempt(lambda: case.runner.attempt(position_id=pid, side="ENTRY",
        attempt_key="PATCH-LEGACY-B", as_of="2026-10-05T12:55:00Z"))
    after = raw(case.runner.store_path)
    out["A1_A2"] = {"before": before, "packet": episode, "direct_default_false": direct, "legacy_attempt": claim,
        "after": after, "independent_cost_basis_usd": str(sum(Decimal(r["admitted_entry_notional_usd_dec"]) for r in after["positions"])),
        "expected_cap_usd": "30", "fake_wire_effects": 0}
finally:
    target = case.root.parent
    case.tearDown()
    out.setdefault("A1_A2", {})["fixture_cleanup_absent"] = not target.exists()

case = fixture()
try:
    case.start_operating(mode="SHADOW")
    ledger, plan = case.wire_files()
    case.coordinator.quote_adapter = RecordingQuoteAdapter(ledger, json.loads(plan.read_text()))
    case.coordinator.tick()
    backup = case.data / "backups/open.sqlite"
    case.coordinator.backup(destination_relative="backups/open.sqlite")
    restored = case.root / "local/fresh-restored"
    restored.mkdir()
    shutil.copyfile(case.data / "offline_runtime.json", restored / "offline_runtime.json")
    runner = TradingContinuityRunner(case.root, data_root=restored)
    recovery = restore_native_backup(backup_path=backup, destination_runner=runner)
    restore_raw = raw(runner.store_path)
    pid = restore_raw["positions"][0]["position_id"]
    runner.command({"command_type": "REQUEST_CLOSE_POSITION", "idempotency_key": "PATCH-CLOSE",
        "position_id": pid})
    before = raw(runner.store_path)
    legacy = attempt(lambda: runner.attempt(position_id=pid, side="EXIT", attempt_key="PATCH-RESTORE-LEGACY",
        as_of="2026-10-05T12:41:00Z"))
    direct_root = case.root / "local/direct-restored"
    direct_root.mkdir()
    shutil.copyfile(case.data / "offline_runtime.json", direct_root / "offline_runtime.json")
    direct_runner = TradingContinuityRunner(case.root, data_root=direct_root)
    restore_native_backup(backup_path=backup, destination_runner=direct_runner)
    direct_runner.command({"command_type": "REQUEST_CLOSE_POSITION", "idempotency_key": "PATCH-DIRECT-CLOSE",
        "position_id": pid})
    direct_before = raw(direct_runner.store_path)
    store = PaperPlaneStore(direct_runner.store_path)
    try:
        direct = attempt(lambda: begin_modeled_attempt(store, position_id=pid, side="EXIT", mode="SHADOW",
            attempt_key="PATCH-RESTORE-DIRECT", decision_at="2026-10-05T12:40:00Z", max_age_seconds=900,
            as_of="2026-10-05T12:41:00Z", ordinary_operating=False))
    finally:
        store.close()
    out["A3"] = {"backup_sha256": hashlib.sha256(backup.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "restore": recovery,
        "restore_raw": restore_raw, "before": before, "legacy_attempt": legacy, "direct_attempt": direct,
        "after": raw(runner.store_path), "direct_before": direct_before,
        "direct_after": raw(direct_runner.store_path), "fake_wire_effects": len(case.ledger_receipts(ledger))}
finally:
    target = case.root.parent
    case.tearDown()
    out["A3"]["fixture_cleanup_absent"] = not target.exists()

print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True))
